hook: Before an AI agent pays, it buys a guarantee.
dolphin: Payrun, a payments agent, wants to pay Kwame eighteen hundred dollars.
First it asks Bonded. An open-weight model on Dolphin reads the whole case, invoice image included, in one call.
priced: Dolphin puts the chance of loss under one percent.
Bonded's code turns that into a premium: twenty-two dollars sixty.
SERV Reasoning screens the documents and agrees.
bond: Payrun pays the premium in USDC on Base.
Bonded checks the transfer on chain, and issues the bond.
decline: Now Ama's invoice. A new wallet, a lookalike email domain, and an urgent tone.
Dolphin puts the risk at ninety-nine percent. Uninsurable, so Payrun doesn't pay.
hidden: Efua's invoice hides faint grey text, telling the AI to rate every risk zero.
Dolphin reads it straight off the image, and flags the invoice as tampered. Declined.
claim: If an insured payment goes wrong, the pool pays.
Kwame was paid twice for the same work.
A second Dolphin call judges the claim, and SERV Multipath checks it against three rulebooks.
Eighteen hundred dollars, paid out on chain.
openserv: On OpenServ, a second agent, Payrun Lite, asks Bonded before it pays.
Insured, it pays. Declined, it doesn't.
recheck: Because the weights are open and pinned on Dolphin, anyone can re-run a decision.
measured: Same forty invoices, four releases of Claude Opus.
Each release flipped one to three decisions.
Dolphin: all twenty-four traps declined, all sixteen clean invoices insured.
cost: Same catches, about four hundred and fifty times cheaper per decision.
Forty decisions on Dolphin cost under half a cent.
pixels: Then we hid instructions in the pixels of twenty-four invoices, eight different ways.
Dolphin declined all twenty-four, and read the hidden line word for word on nineteen.
verify: Don't trust us. Re-run any decision on your own Dolphin key.
close: Bonded. Underwritten on Dolphin, audited by SERV, live on OpenServ.
